codeReview.summary: The final-validation feature correctly verified all three cross-area validation assertions and updated TASKS.md. The commit (5edcfa2) touches only TASKS.md — 7 lines changed from [ ] to [x], marking completed software items that were implemented in prior features but not yet checked off. No code changes were made, which is correct for a validation-only feature.

issues.description: The `non_cmd_count` variable is incremented in three places (lines 276, 287, 307) but the assigned value is never read before being overwritten or going out of scope. The compiler warns about this consistently across all 3 ESP32 feature sets. This is a pre-existing code smell, not introduced by this feature, and does not affect correctness.

summary: PASS. Final validation feature successfully verified all three cross-area assertions: (1) cargo test --workspace passes with 384 tests and 0 failures across all crates (launa-core: 31, launa-esp-ota: 46, launa-hal: 18, launa-integration-tests: 124, launa-mqtt: 45, launa-ota: 14, launa-protocol: 39, launa-sim: 133, xtask: 31, plus doc-tests), (2) cargo +esp check compiles cleanly for all 3 feature sets (default, sniff, hw-test) — warnings only, no errors, (3) cargo fmt --check --all produces no diffs. TASKS.md was correctly updated: 7 software items marked as completed, leaving only 15 hardware-dependent items unchecked (USB driver install, cargo-espflash install, bootstrap path, field session sniffing, RS-485 bench setup, field testing, OTA hardware test, esp-rtos evaluation, heap fragmentation analysis, RS-485 transceiver reset). All unchecked items are legitimately hardware-dependent and cannot be resolved on desktop.
